title: PR report
description: What a role shows a person about its change. The factory renders every factory PR, setup PR and escalation from these, in one layout: a three-line summary, an ordered mix of proof files and diagrams, the key things to focus on, and links to the spec and the longer breakdowns. Doc 07.

summary.description: At most three lines a person reads first: what changed, why, and what they would notice.

blocks.description: Proof files and diagrams, in the order a person should see them. As many as the change needs.

file.description: Path of a file the role wrote, relative to its report directory: a screenshot, GIF, video, log or API response.

poster.description: For a video: an image or GIF of it, shown inline and linking to the video, which GitHub does not play from a repository.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source; GitHub draws it in place.

focus.description: The biggest changes a reviewer should be aware of.

technical.description: Path of the technical breakdown (markdown), relative to the report directory: how the change works, file by file.

conceptual.description: Path of the conceptual breakdown (markdown), relative to the report directory: what the change means and why it is shaped this way.
